payload.core_composition_summary: Single DP over waves with state (bullets_left, total_spent). Greedy reload feasibility checks are integrated into DP transitions, not separate mechanisms.
payload.rationale: The solution uses DP with states tracking magazine bullets and total bullets spent. Reload decisions use local greedy checks (min reloads, whether to reload after wave if time allows) but these are part of DP transitions, not a distinct algorithmic component.
